<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|“What we have here is the refiner's garden,” Dross said from the gem in Lindon's pocket.}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|— ''Ghostwater'', chapter 15}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Dross Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Dross is a unique memory [[construct]] and [[spirit]] originally discovered by [[Lindon]] within an [[oracle tree]] in [[Ghostwater]]. Though he is a compilation of various minds and spirits that have evolved into an individual, he remains fundamentally a memory [[spirit]]. Dross possesses a foundation in [[Soulsmithing]] due to the information [[constructs]] he absorbed from [[Soulsmiths]], which allows him to assist [[Lindon]] with tasks such as separating memories and assembling [[constructs]]. Dross's physical appearance has undergone significant evolution. He often manifests as a round, purple-skinned entity with a single large eye and two small, arm-like tendrils. His form has transitioned from a nebulous cloud of light and phantom gears to more substantial iterations, including a version with skin, a mouth lined with tiny teeth, and even more advanced forms that resemble a cross between a [[sacred beast]] and a [[spirit]]. He can reside within [[Lindon's core]] or inhabit vessels such as gemstones. In combat and utility, Dross serves as a versatile companion capable of remote communication, piloting ships, and providing tactical insights. He has demonstrated the ability to expand his capacity through intense power, though over-exerting himself can cause physical damage and transformation. While he possesses a distinct personality—often characterized by theatricality, curiosity, and occasional cowardice—he is an invaluable asset to [[Lindon]]'s journey.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Dross has undergone many transformations, appearing variously as a rusted metal ball, a floating purple cloud of light with phantom gears, or a dark-colored [[spirit]]. His physical form often features a large single eye, a mouth with sharp teeth, and two stubby, boneless arms. In later stages, he can manifest as a red entity or wear a purple-[[white halo]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A cunning and knowledgeable mind-[[spirit]], Dross acts as a guide and companion who provides commentary, combat solutions, and predictions. He can be arrogant, cackling or speaking with an unnerving voice, yet he also serves to restrain murderous impulses and soothe egos. He possesses a desire to ascend and has shown an interest in games and eating memories.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Dross is a companion and mind-[[spirit]] to [[Lindon]], residing within his core and providing guidance, simulations, and combat assistance. He has interacted with [[Yerin]] by providing her with records of [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]], creating models of her for combat training, and placing information into her brain. Dross also communicates with [[Mercy]], [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]], and Blue, and has been commanded by [[Lindon]] to direct [[Little Blue]]. Additionally, Dross has interacted with [[Eithan]], [[Orthos]], and [[Northstrider]], and can communicate with the [[Golds]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Dross utilizes [[dream madra]] to create illusory clones, project images, and perform mental attacks. He is a master of information, capable of running complex simulations, modeling behaviors, and processing vast amounts of memories. Additionally, he can manipulate perceptions, accelerate processing speeds, and use the [[Silent King's madra]] to project audible speech illusions.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Keeper of the Dream Well}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Dross is a living memory [[construct]] that identifies as the Keeper of the [[Dream Well]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c6">''Ghostwater'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c8">''Ghostwater'', chapter 8</ref> Originally a guide-[[construct]] built near the [[Dream Well]] and previously known by derogatory names such as junk or failure, this rusted metal ball gained the ability to think and combine words after falling into the well.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c6" /> Utilizing [[dream madra]], this [[Eye of the Deep]] is capable of being bound to a gem like an original [[construct]].<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c6" /><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c8" /> After being merged with a [[sapphire]], Dross's form became a defined orb containing an interlocking mechanism of gears and two cores.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c8" /> This operation granted the [[construct]] senses like a [[Jade]] and transformed its form into a purple cloud filled with violet sparks.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c8" /> Now existing as a gem that can flash and contain [[madra]], Dross can drift as a floating purple cloud of light, phantom gears, and swimming violet lights.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c9">''Ghostwater'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c10">''Ghostwater'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c12">''Ghostwater'', chapter 12</ref> Despite being a jewel that emits purple light, the [[construct]] can lose memories as it decays.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c11">''Ghostwater'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c12" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Spirit of Lindon's soul}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Dross is a glowing companion to [[Lindon]] and a purple, one-eyed parasite that infests his soul.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c7">''Underlord'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c8">''Underlord'', chapter 8</ref> This speaking [[spirit]] can exit [[Lindon]]'s soul to hover on his shoulder, though he often communicates with [[Lindon]] silently.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c8" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c9">''Underlord'', chapter 9</ref> While watching [[Eithan]]'s presentation, Dross remained aware that the [[Akura clan]] was unaware [[Mercy]] had left [[Akura Harmony|Harmony]] to die.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c7" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c8" /> As a [[spirit]] that resides at the base of [[Lindon]]'s skull or works through his body, Dross uses [[Lindon]]'s senses and smooths out his thoughts.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c11">''Underlord'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c12">''Underlord'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c14">''Underlord'', chapter 14</ref> He runs on excess [[dream aura]] produced by [[Lindon]]'s mind and requires [[Dream Well water]], as he lacks a digestive system.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c11" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c12" /> Dross can provide combat predictions and solutions, simulate experiments in [[Lindon]]'s head, or even manufacture weapons if provided with blueprints.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c11" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c14" /> Having absorbed many information [[constructs]] from [[Ghostwater]], the purple [[spirit]] with stubby arms can also alter memories while people sleep.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c14" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c18">''Underlord'', chapter 18</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Dross possesses the ability to slide out of [[Lindon's body]] and can provide assistance to a [[Soulsmith]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c18" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c19">''Underlord'', chapter 19</ref> Through dream simulations, Dross has demonstrated the effects of combining various techniques.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c19" /> In addition to providing combat reports, Dross has examined [[Lindon's axe]] alongside him.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20">''Underlord'', chapter 20</ref> His purple body is characterized by a large eye that occupies most of his form.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c21">''Underlord'', chapter 21</ref> Dross is capable of suggesting the use of [[Sage's madra]] and has accompanied [[Lindon]] on his journeys.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c21" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c22">''Underlord'', chapter 22</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Guide in the Uncrowned era}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Residing within [[Lindon]]'s mind and [[spirit]], Dross is a whistling companion who enjoys playing games.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c2">''Uncrowned'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c3">''Uncrowned'', chapter 3</ref> This [[spirit]], created from [[Northstrider]]'s [[Ghostwater]], can enhance [[Lindon]]'s mind, process the essence of a [[scale]], and simulate battles.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c3" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c4">''Uncrowned'', chapter 4</ref> Dross constantly watches [[Lindon]], pointing out things like the [[Sage]]'s owl and providing conversations to help him focus.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c5">''Uncrowned'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c6">''Uncrowned'', chapter 6</ref> After significantly improving a [[Akura Pride|Pride]] model, Dross created a model of [[Yerin]] for [[Lindon]] to fight.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c6" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c7">''Uncrowned'', chapter 7</ref> The entity can explain context clues and understand [[Lindon]]'s worries, even suggesting he use [[black dragon's breath|dragon's breath]] to attack a base or bribe a man during the second trial.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c9">''Uncrowned'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c11">''Uncrowned'', chapter 11</ref> Dross can play back memories, serve as a tool for taking notes, and note that [[Lindon's mother]] is watching.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c12">''Uncrowned'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c13">''Uncrowned'', chapter 13</ref> By counting people present and providing various observations and information, Dross gives [[Lindon]] an edge in combat.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c14">''Uncrowned'', chapter 14</ref> As a guide who once called the crown an imposter, Dross can be trained against via a model and is a mind-[[spirit]] that [[Lindon]] worries about while planning to figure things out together.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c15">''Uncrowned'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c16">''Uncrowned'', chapter 16</ref> Dross can manifest over [[Lindon]]'s shoulder, using a mental voice to guide his combat.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c19">''Uncrowned'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c20">''Uncrowned'', chapter 20</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Born from [[Ghostwater]] during its final days, Dross is a partially immaterial mind-[[spirit]] who appeared on [[Lindon]] and reacted to the arrival of the [[Abidan]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c2">''Wintersteel'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c3">''Wintersteel'', chapter 3</ref> After [[Lindon]] confronted him following Judge Suriel{{!}}Suriel's visit, it became clear that Dross can steal memories and provide combat solutions.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c3" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c4">''Wintersteel'', chapter 4</ref> As an observing companion who provides commentary, Dross created a predictive model for [[Blacksword]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c6">''Wintersteel'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7">''Wintersteel'', chapter 7</ref> [[Northstrider]] tested whether Dross's initiative and ability to propose solutions were tied to self-awareness, while also examining his spiritual structure and capacity to see if replication was possible without a fifty-year wait.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7" /> Emerging from the [[oracle codex]], Dross suggested that a gathering might be caused by the position of the stars.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8">''Wintersteel'', chapter 8</ref> Dross assisted [[Lindon]] with his [[Lindon's skeletal Remnant arm|Remnant arm]] and found the sacred [[spiders]] to be fascinating.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c9">''Wintersteel'', chapter 9</ref> The entity suggested the name [[Hollow Domain]] for a new [[technique]] and can provide reminders of [[Lindon]]'s fights or comment on his appearance.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c10">''Wintersteel'', chapter 10</ref> Dross helped [[Lindon]] process energies using the [[Heart of Twin Stars]] and can use limited information to assist his perception.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c13">''Wintersteel'', chapter 13</ref> Capable of taking control of [[Wavedancer]] or residing within [[Lindon's armor]], Dross can perform tests inside his mind.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c13" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c14">''Wintersteel'', chapter 14</ref> While traveling with [[Lindon]] and [[Charity]], Dross runs on [[dream aura]] and can remember facts from [[tournament]] records and tests.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c14" />}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|While drifting in the darkness with [[Lindon]], Dross demonstrated the ability to project images onto a deck.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c18" /> As a [[spirit]] capable of memorizing [[dream tablets]], Dross sorted through [[Lindon]]'s memories and assisted him in reasoning through the possibility of draining [[madra]] from the [[Wandering Titan]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c23">''Wintersteel'', chapter 23</ref> After hovering over [[Lindon]]'s face, Dross provided an analysis of Sopharanatoth{{!}}Sophara's fighting style to [[Ruby]] and gave [[Yerin]] records regarding her.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c25">''Wintersteel'', chapter 25</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26">''Wintersteel'', chapter 26</ref> Acting as a companion to [[Lindon]] who provides various scenarios, Dross reported that [[Yerin]] had won.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26" /> Dross helped bring [[Northstrider]]'s weapon together and remarked that it would be rude not to join the gang.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27">''Wintersteel'', chapter 27</ref> Communicating with [[Lindon]] via messages, the [[spirit]] shouted a warning and noted that [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]] would return in approximately two seconds.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27" /> Dross holds onto memories and informed [[Lindon]] that he was not an Overlord.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c28">''Wintersteel'', chapter 28</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Trapped in a skull}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Trapped inside a living skull, Dross is a [[spirit]] capable of speaking into people's minds and possesses the ability to soothe egos.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c9" /><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c11">''Bloodline'', chapter 11</ref> This entity can manipulate light images to assign tasks and holds knowledge that [[Lindon]] does not possess.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c9" /><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c11" /> Dross can contact the [[Golds]] and provides reports regarding the [[First Elder]]'s [[technique]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c12">''Bloodline'', chapter 12</ref> While correcting [[Lindon]]'s count of the [[Li clan]] members and shouting for him to look east, Dross demonstrates his utility by === {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Reconstruction in the labyrinth}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Dross is a memory [[spirit]] composed of numerous minds and spirits that can manifest as a spinning purple ball of [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c7">''Reaper'', chapter 7</ref> The entity's internal structure is made of [[madra channels]] and organic rings, though [[Lindon]] must work to fix him.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c7" /> While more stable than in recent times, Dross has become a pale, washed-out gray blob with a personality characterized by a passionless and dry recital of words.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c9">''Reaper'', chapter 9</ref> His physical form features two boneless pseudopod arms, one mouth with sharp teeth, and a single large eye.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c9" /> Dross has noted that the [[Sword Sage]] escaped [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]] and observed that the facility's foundation predates the founding of the Arelius family{{!}}Arelius line by centuries.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c10">''Reaper'', chapter 10</ref> Functioning as a [[spirit]] that can simulate [[Soulsmithing]] projects, he logs weaknesses for future use and warns that replacing [[madra]] or [[soulfire]] used in battle is difficult.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c11">''Reaper'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c13">''Reaper'', chapter 13</ref> He is capable of locating [[binding|bindings]], linking [[Lindon]] to [[constructs]], and slowing down the world.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c12">''Reaper'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c16">''Reaper'', chapter 16</ref> Dross has provided information regarding [[dream tablets]] and the lack of ways to replenish [[dream aura]], while also suggesting that [[Reigan Shen]] is attempting to preserve lives or the tridents.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c14">''Reaper'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c16" /> After pitting himself against a [[technique]], he mentioned that [[Northstrider]] previously used him to develop a combat report against [[Reigan Shen]] and assessed that [[Eithan]] was denying an [[advancement]] to [[Sage]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c16" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c17">''Reaper'', chapter 17</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Evolved spirit}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Having evolved into an irreversible [[spirit]] of true power, Dross wears a tiny, spiked black crown.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c17" /> This almighty mind-[[spirit]], who possesses a shell and a large eye, claimed that [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]] fed upon [[Mercy]]'s mother.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c18">''Reaper'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c20">''Reaper'', chapter 20</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c26">''Reaper'', chapter 26</ref> Dross spoke to [[Lindon]] with arrogance and cackled inside his head, though the living [[construct]] can also declare when an application of [[hunger madra]] is beyond a person's understanding.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c19">''Reaper'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c20" /> As a ball of [[dream madra]] located at the base of [[Lindon]]'s skull, Dross can help restore [[Lindon]]'s strength and provides combat solutions and reports.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c21">''Reaper'', chapter 21</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c23">''Reaper'', chapter 23</ref> While providing silent support and being mentioned in relation to time slowing, the [[construct]]—which [[Eithan]] cannot repair unless it prevents further world damage—volunteered to be the first test subject for [[hunger binding]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c22">''Reaper'', chapter 22</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c23" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c26" /> Dross carries the burden of glorious knowledge and stated that information from the dead [[Dreadgod]] will support his purpose, noting that [[Reigan Shen]] had slain the beast.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c22" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c25">''Reaper'', chapter 25</ref> The [[construct]], which [[Lindon]] made and asked to remember runes, desires to ascend.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c25" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c27">''Reaper'', chapter 27</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|After sustaining damage from over-drafting himself for [[Lindon]], Dross transformed into a new form as an echo with functions exceeding anything normally possible in [[Cradle]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c2">''Dreadgod'', chapter 2</ref> This dark, floating [[spirit]] can inspect and remember [[labyrinth]] details, examine the structure of [[Divine Treasure|Divine Treasures]], and project memories or echoes.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c2" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c3">''Dreadgod'', chapter 3</ref> Identifying himself as Dross, the dark-minded mind-[[construct]] can receive [[dream aura]] from [[Lindon]] and desires the [[Silent King]]'s [[dream madra]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c2" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c3" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c4">''Dreadgod'', chapter 4</ref> The entity can manifest in the air to whisper that [[Lindon]] is a man at war with an internal battlefield, and he can also explain images or shift attention to others.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c3" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c5">''Dreadgod'', chapter 5</ref> While theorizing countermeasures against the [[Dreadgod]]'s possession, Dross drifted out of the back of [[Lindon]]'s neck.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c4" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c5" /> Dross has since piloted [[Windfall]] and simulated death and [[destruction]] permutations to find ways to avoid the [[Titan]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c8">''Dreadgod'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c15">''Dreadgod'', chapter 15</ref> Though he can clear [[Lindon]]'s memories in an instant, Dross noted that even he could not unravel the [[Silent King]]'s lie or break his mirage.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c15" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c16">''Dreadgod'', chapter 16</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Silent King encounter}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|As [[Lindon]]'s companion and mind-[[spirit]], Dross communicates telepathically with [[Kelsa]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c17">''Dreadgod'', chapter 17</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18">''Dreadgod'', chapter 18</ref> This dark-purple entity can materialize with a violet shine and feeds on excess [[dream aura]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18" /> During the vision involving [[Lindon]] and the [[Silent King]], Dross was present but was shoved aside by the [[Dreadgod]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18" /> While [[Lindon]] consumed the [[Silent King]], Dross helped prevent him from collapsing by absorbing the king's memories and dream [[aspects]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19">''Dreadgod'', chapter 19</ref> Residing within [[Lindon]]'s [[spirit]], Dross possesses light purple pebbly skin and can manifest a purple-[[white halo]] over his head.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19" /> Dross whispered into [[Yerin]]'s mind and remained aware of the physical toll being taken on [[Lindon's skeletal Remnant arm|Lindon's arm]] and eyes.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Ghostwater journey}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Born in the world of [[Ghostwater]], Dross is a character capable of manifesting next to [[Lindon]] and providing information regarding [[Mercy]]'s [[madra channels]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c2">''Waybound'', chapter 2</ref> He notes that certain items are more than simple [[constructs]] and expresses a desire to eat memories.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c2" /> A being that does not require breathing, Dross speaks to [[Lindon]] in a strange manner while interacting with both him and [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c3">''Waybound'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c4">''Waybound'', chapter 4</ref> He presents a catalogue of memories from [[Soulsmiths]] for [[Lindon]] to consider and offers projections and commentary during combat.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c4" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c5">''Waybound'', chapter 5</ref> Dross can taste thoughts and offered to chase a target using projection, though he believes [[Lindon]] is too much for the Array.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c6">''Waybound'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c7">''Waybound'', chapter 7</ref> Communicating with [[Lindon]] and [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] through a [[void key]], he helped [[Lindon]] locate the [[Sword Sage]]'s echo while watching him take notes.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c7" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c8">''Waybound'', chapter 8</ref> He even remarked that someone ought to take lessons from him regarding style.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c9">''Waybound'', chapter 9</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Mercy's mind}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|After being slid into place, Dross inhabits [[Mercy]]'s senses and mind in a red [[spirit]] form.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" /> Though he is a smaller copy of his original self and lacks his former power, he can communicate with [[Yerin]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c20" /> Dross has evolved into a mighty hive-mind of multiple instances, existing across several bodies.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21">''Waybound'', chapter 21</ref><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23">''Waybound'', chapter 23</ref> An entity of unparalleled cunning and knowledge, he suggested that [[Lindon]] engage in [[Soulsmithing]] for a break.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c21" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23" /> While aboard [[Windfall]] with [[Lindon]], Dross noted that [[Northstrider]] was calculating his angle during the interaction.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c23" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c24">''Waybound'', chapter 24</ref> He proposed that [[Yerin]] should be the one to kill [[Northstrider]], noting he could simulate what [[Northstrider]] sees using memories from an echo.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c24" /> Dross is capable of performing impressions of others, which can include sporting a shaggy mane of hair or having a gold eye.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c24" /> As [[Mercy]]'s Dross, he can sense [[Lindon]]'s presence but finds himself missing his original self.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c25">''Waybound'', chapter 25</ref> He suggested using the strength of the [[Dragon Icon]] to assist [[Mercy]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c26">''Waybound'', chapter 26</ref> Dross can highlight entities in [[Lindon]]'s vision, suggest the use of [[Soul Cloak]], and help identify pinpoint timing.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c27">''Waybound'', chapter 27</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Presence of the Wolves}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Dross possesses the potential to influence the [[oracle codex]] and is capable of communicating with [[Mercy]], sometimes manifesting directly upon her shoulder. 1, 2, 5<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 6</ref> As a combat [[Presence]], this red entity receives and transmits information from the [[Presence of the Wolves]] while suggesting an enemy is involved. 3, 4, 12, 30<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6" /><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c10">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 12</ref> Although his predictive abilities have decreased due to a reduced connection to [[Way|the Way]], Dross can sense the meaning of a [[giant]] raven's caw. 6, 10<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6" /><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 7</ref> Dross has spiked teeth and can manifest wearing the pure-[[white halo]] of the [[Silent King]], a phenomenon he can also replicate when using his powers. 7, 8, 18<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" /><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 11</ref> This entity features boneless arms and a single purple eye, utilizing the [[Silent King's madra]] to project audible speech illusions. 14, 15, 19, 23<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11" /> Possessing the power of memory, Dross can read memories and has learned to mimic human speech. 16, 17, 21<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11" /> Dross communicates with [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] through mental messages and spies on [[Eternity]] facilities, even accompanying him on a mission. 20, 22, 27<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c11" /><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12" />}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|“You’re a memory construct, aren’t you?”<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c6" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|“I am the Eye of the Deep now,” Dross said confidently.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c8" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|“What we have here is the refiner's garden,” Dross said from the gem in Lindon's pocket.<ref name="cradle-05-ghostwater-c15" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|“I’m examining him to see if his initiative and ability to propose solutions are tied to his personality and self-awareness,” Northstrider responded.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|“I am also testing his capacity and resolve, as well as his spiritual structure. I would like to see if replication is possible without waiting fifty years.”<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7" />}}
